Через запятую. Название организации, её: Comma-separated. The organization name, its abbreviation, city, domain - words that tie the code to the organization. In every request to a model, local or external, they are replaced with "org" / "{org_ru}" - in code, paths, rules and scanner messages; matching is case-insensitive on whole words and identifier parts ("acmeist" and "Contora" are left alone). "*" at the end matches any word with that beginning. The finding card shows the code as is. Empty - no replacement.
Через запятую. Библиотеки, имя которых н: Comma-separated. Components whose name starts with such a prefix are the organization's own components: they are not included in the package for external agents.

Находка SCA срочная, если её CVSS не ниж: An SCA finding is urgent if its CVSS is not below the threshold; such findings go first in triage. SCA severity in a Hub export is the Hub policy level, not the vulnerability severity, so urgency is based on CVSS. After the threshold changes, the triage order in all projects is recalculated.

Модель с рассуждением отвечает дольше: р: A reasoning model answers more slowly: reasoning gets its own room in the window and its own timeout. gpt-oss models understand the low to high levels; for other models reasoning is simply enabled.
Сколько текста модель видит за раз: пром: How much text the model sees at once: the prompt with code and the answer. A larger window needs more video memory. Empty - as in the application settings ({n}).
Авто: разбор – до 3072 токенов (не больш: Auto: triage - up to 3072 tokens (no more than a quarter of the window); with reasoning - the rest of the window after the prompt, up to 8192; answer timeout - 900 s, with reasoning - 2400 s.
Сервер в сети: разрешить выгружать модел: Network server: allow unloading the model if it becomes slow (a shared server may run other people's tasks - off by default)
По умолчанию для разбора кода во всех пр: Default for code analysis in all projects
Профиль по умолчанию действует на все пр: The default profile applies to all projects that have no profile of their own. Code is sent to an external provider only for projects marked "code is not secret" (training example projects and Demo Library have it from the start; for other projects it is set in the project parameters after the preview). For a project without the mark, triage through this profile is refused - choose another profile for it in "Project parameters".
Сохраняю и жду ответ…: Saving and waiting for an answer…
Сохранить и проверить поиск (расходует з: Save and test search (uses a request)
Профили серверов, где работает модель: O: Profiles of the servers where the model runs: Ollama on this computer, a server in the organization network, or an external provider over the Chat Completions API or Anthropic Messages API. You can have any number of profiles - saving one does not affect the others. The default profile analyzes code in all projects that have no profile of their own.
